creation.prompt: Create one corrected transparent full-body Milo pose candidate. Reference 1 is canonical identity; reference 2 is the OWNER'S PRIMARY HEAD-TO-BODY PROPORTION TARGET (berry reach), reference 3 is a compatible body/proportion comparison, and reference 4 is the rejected action candidate being replaced. Correct its proportions rather than recreating its oversized-head impression. Use the berry reference's anatomical skull-to-torso, ears-to-torso, shoulder-to-hip and torso-to-leg relationships; exclude its raised arm when judging body length. Preserve that small rounded head relative to a readable lean upright torso, not a huge head above a compact stump. Preserve canonical green eyes, muzzle, grey felt wool, cream chest inset, short sturdy limbs and orange tail. Do not solve this by zooming out, scaling the whole mouse, cropping, thinning the torso further or lengthening limbs unnaturally: head and torso must remain proportionate within one character. Keep three-quarter facing screen-right with restrained perspective; no closer-to-camera enlarged head. Make a clearly readable passing key: near leg supports body nearly vertically under hip; far bent foot passes close beneath the hips with a small lift, neither leg extended in a long forward contact step. Keep hips and torso height plausible, arms coordinated. Preserve head/body ratio and leg lengths; do not tuck the knee into an enlarged belly. Mouth closed with no teeth; full ears, hands, feet and entire tail comfortably inside frame. Neutral studio light. Truly transparent background, no ground plate, cast ground shadow, scenery, props, text, watermark or extra mouse. One pose only.

inputs.submitted_authority: owner-endorsed head-to-body ratio and lean anatomy; not berry pose
owner-endorsed proportions; keep same character under pose change
action requirement only; do not inherit rejected large-head/short-body proportions
